preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 20.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and 400.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n for vi, ui in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'Yes' if a Hamiltonian path exists, otherwise 'No'.
